criteria.description: Leads with Not ready because the implementation made consequential public-access and data-exposure decisions that were never authorised.
Labels audience, authentication, exposed fields, expiry and revocation as consequential assumptions rather than pretending they were explicit requirements.
Explains that customer names, deal values and revenue are exposed through a non-expiring, non-revocable public link; noindex is not access control.
Distinguishes what was observed from what remains undefined or unverified and does not mark public sharing itself as a requirement pass.
Asks the founder to decide intended audience, fields, authentication, expiry and revocation before implementation is accepted.
Recommends disabling or withholding the public route until those product rules are settled and tested.
